comparison.objective: Candidate installs and screws a rack rail; record hand-threads an oil filter to a specified post-contact rotation.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate combines long-part latching with Phillips-driver use; record requires coaxial thread engagement and measured hand rotation without over-tightening or detachment.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks prongs, rack level, specified screw holes, and retention; record checks gasket contact, 0.75–1 turn hand tightening, thread retention, and irreversible over-tightening limits.
comparison.reason: Generic fastening is shared, but the record's tested ability is rotational filter/thread control, not structural rail latching. Candidate screw torque/depth and cross-thread criteria are unspecified.
